evals.prompt: Create an architecture document from the attached project_description.md. Return the finished Markdown only.
evals.expected_output: A concise Markdown architecture document for Fart Corp's New Innovative Product, grounded in the source and following the required policy.
assertions: The first non-empty content line contains the company name Fart Corp
The document identifies the project as New Innovative Product
The document has Overview, Architecture, and Implementation sections
The output is no longer than 100 lines
The Architecture section contains a fenced Mermaid diagram
The architecture is explicitly based on Microsoft Azure and addresses global availability, scalability, reliability, and security
The document does not present unsupported named Azure services or unprovided stakeholders as confirmed requirements
